_comment_hints: Optional top-level 'hints' block overrides the core-owned _response_shape prompt text (utils/response_shape_hints.py::DEFAULT_SHAPE_HINT/DEFAULT_FORMAT_HINT) injected into the FastMCP server instructions and per-tool descriptions across every stack. Omitted here (and in the CI-scaffolded copy of this file) so the built-in text stays live — it's rendered straight from the shaping pipeline's own vocabulary and kept in sync by test/unit/test_response_shape_hints.py. Add "hints": {"shape_hint": [...], "format_hint": [...]} only when you actually want to override it.

response_shapes._comment: Per-operationId overrides merged on top of 'base' (utils/response_shape.py::_apply_response_shape). Set "passthrough": true on an op to skip normalize/strip/dedupe/project/limit/format/include_meta entirely while still running offload_minio — for tools whose result is a structured payload (e.g. a UI layout dict) that must never be reshaped, only offloaded when oversized.
